players.product: Power-secured HPC/AI data-center lease campuses (Lake Mariner NY for Fluidstack/Google; Justified & Muskie KY) - ex-Bitcoin-mining conversion

quarterly_data.signal: TeraWulf acquired the Muskie Data Campus in Eastern Kentucky from Industrial Equity Partners under a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement (closed effective May 22, 2026): approximately 285 acres of owned and controlled land expected to support up to 1 GW of data center capacity over time, with delivery of the initial 500 MW expected to ramp beginning in the second half of 2028 and an additional 500 MW targeted for delivery in the second half of 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 285 acres; initial 500 MW ramping from the second half of 2028; additional 500 MW targeted for the second half of 2030
